seo_title: Marketing Courses in Azerbaijan — FAQ | Marketing School
seo_description: Answers about Marketing School's online marketing and digital marketing courses: price, language, format, live sessions, mentoring, diploma and careers.
lede: Short, direct answers to the questions people ask most before choosing an online marketing or digital marketing course.

items.q: Are there online marketing courses in Azerbaijan?
items.a: Yes. Marketing School, based in Baku, runs two online courses taught in Azerbaijani: the [Marketing Course](kurs:marketinq-kursu) and the [Digital Marketing Course](kurs:digital-marketinq-kursu). Each is a 3-month programme of recorded video lessons with live Q&A twice a month, case-based homework, a one-to-one mentoring session and a diploma. Each course costs 99 AZN per month.

items.q: How much does the course cost?
items.a: Each course costs 99 AZN per month and is billed separately: the Marketing Course is 99 AZN per month and the Digital Marketing Course is 99 AZN per month. Paying for one course does not give access to the other. You can stop automatic monthly payment at any time; you keep access until the end of the period you have paid for.

items.q: What language is the course taught in?
items.a: Both courses are taught in Azerbaijani. Video lessons, live Q&A sessions and homework feedback are all in Azerbaijani. The website and the learning platform interface are also available in English and Russian, but the course content itself is in Azerbaijani.

items.q: Can I try the course for free?
items.a: Yes. When you fill in the demo form, you get 24 hours of free access to the first 2 modules of the course you choose. The 24 hours start when you sign up. The demo is available once per person. If you then pay, you continue with the same account and keep everything you watched and noted.

items.q: What is the difference between the Marketing Course and the Digital Marketing Course?
items.a: The Marketing Course teaches marketing decisions: market and customer research, brand positioning, pricing, campaign planning and measurement. The Digital Marketing Course teaches how to carry out those decisions in online channels: SEO, social media, Meta and Google advertising, Google Analytics 4 and conversion optimisation.

items.q: Which course should I start with?
items.a: Start with the Marketing Course if you want to see the big picture and make brand-level decisions. Start with the Digital Marketing Course if you want practical skills quickly and plan to work in social media, paid advertising or SEO. Many students take both, one after the other.

items.q: Can I learn marketing from scratch? Are there any prerequisites?
items.a: Yes, both courses are designed for complete beginners and suit beginner to intermediate learners. For the Digital Marketing Course you only need to be comfortable using a computer.

items.q: How long does the course take?
items.a: The standard length is 3 months, but there is no hard deadline. Lessons are recorded and you study at your own pace; if you need more time, you can continue month by month at 99 AZN per month. The Marketing Course has 9 modules and the Digital Marketing Course has 10.

items.q: How does the online format work? Can I watch at my own pace?
items.a: Yes. The course is fully online: the lessons are recorded videos you can watch at any time, on any device. On top of that there are live online Q&A sessions twice a month, homework in every module and a one-to-one mentoring session once you finish the lessons.

items.q: When are the live Q&A sessions?
items.a: Live online sessions take place on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of every month at 11:00 Baku time (UTC+4). The instructor answers questions and discusses homework and real cases. You can send your question in advance on the platform, and recordings are available afterwards.

items.q: What is the one-to-one mentoring session?
items.a: Once you have completed every lesson in the course, you book a private online session with your instructor through the platform's calendar. You go over your assignment results, your strengths and gaps, and the next steps for your career or business.

items.q: What is the homework like?
items.a: Every module has an assignment based on a real marketing case. You apply what you have just learned, your instructor grades it and gives written feedback, and selected assignments are discussed in the live sessions.

items.q: Do I get a diploma or certificate?
items.a: Yes. Students who score at least 75% of the total points across the mandatory assignments receive a Marketing School diploma. Each diploma has a unique public verification link that you can add to LinkedIn, and it stays valid even after your paid period ends.

items.q: What does the Digital Marketing Course cover?
items.a: The [Digital Marketing Course](kurs:digital-marketinq-kursu) has 10 modules: introduction to digital marketing, website and user experience, technical SEO, content SEO, social media marketing, Meta advertising, Google advertising, Google Analytics 4, conversion rate optimisation, and email marketing and automation.

items.q: Does the course teach Google Ads and Meta Ads?
items.a: Yes. The Digital Marketing Course has dedicated modules on Meta advertising (Facebook and Instagram) and Google advertising: building campaigns, choosing audiences and keywords, testing creatives and managing budgets. Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and Google Analytics 4 are used hands-on.

items.q: What does the Marketing Course cover?
items.a: The [Marketing Course](kurs:marketinq-kursu) has 9 modules: marketing fundamentals, customer and market research, competitor analysis, brand positioning, growing a brand, pricing, campaign planning, channels and execution, and measurement and reporting.

items.q: Is the Marketing Course useful for business owners?
items.a: Yes. You can apply every assignment to your own business: customer, positioning, pricing, channel and budget decisions. In the mentoring session you can also discuss a specific business question with the instructor.

items.q: What jobs can I get after a digital marketing course?
items.a: Graduates apply for roles such as digital marketing specialist, SMM manager, paid media (performance) specialist, SEO specialist and content specialist. After the Marketing Course, typical roles are marketing specialist and brand manager.

items.q: Do you guarantee a job after the course?
items.a: No, we do not offer job placement. Instead, every student has a one-to-one mentoring session with the instructor to plan the next steps for their career.

items.q: Who are the instructors?
items.a: The Marketing Course is taught by Hasanali Ildirimov, Head of the Non-Food Category at Azersun Holding. The Digital Marketing Course is taught by Zamir Shabanov, Leading Digital Marketing Specialist at AzInTelecom. Both work in marketing today.

items.q: How does payment work, and can I cancel?
items.a: You pay 99 AZN per month by card for each course. Payments renew automatically each month, and you can turn this off at any time from your account. Cancelling does not cut off the time you have already paid for: you keep access until the end of the paid period, plus a 3-day grace period. Your progress, scores and diploma are always kept.
